name: NASA International Space Apps Challenge
organizer: NASA Space Apps Global Organizing Team
venue: In-person and virtual Local Events worldwide, plus the virtual Universal Event

timeline.what: Challenge summaries published; team formation opens
Full challenge statements with data sets and requirements
Project Submission and Judging & Awards guides published
Hackathon starts; project submission opens 09:00 local time
December 2026: Global Nominees, Finalists and Honorable Mentions announced

criteria.label: Impact
criteria.description: Carried from 2025 until the 2026 Judging & Awards guide is published (2026-11-13).

judging.judge_profile_summary: Expected three phases as in 2025: Local/Universal Event judges → NASA and Space Agency Partner subject-matter experts → an executive committee of agency leaders.
judging.notes: Criteria and award list are provisional until 2026-11-13. Recognition for 2026 Global Winners is 'to be announced'.

required_tech: At least one NASA data source or resource (expected, as in 2025)
submission_requirements: Teams of at most six, all registered for the same Local Event or the Universal Event
Teams must not begin working on the challenges before the hackathon
Submit through the team's project page on spaceappschallenge.org by the end of the Local Event

sources.note: Dates, theme, timeline, team rules, no work before the hackathon.

curator_notes: Dogfood target for the /hack-plan harness (hack-plan/nasa-space-apps-2026/). Prior: nasa-space-apps-2025.
